okf_version.title: OKF spec version
okf_version.description: The okf_version okfit writes into a bundle-root index.md that declares none (okfit init, okfit sync). The bundle's own declaration decides how it is read.

path.title: Bundle directory
path.description: The OKF bundle's root directory, relative to the project root.

profile.title: Profile name
profile.description: The named profile merged under `DEFAULTS < profile < file`, or "none" to disable profile merging.

bundle.title: Bundle location and profile
bundle.description: Where the OKF bundle lives and which profile merges under it.

required.title: Required frontmatter keys
required.description: Frontmatter keys every concept must carry, beyond the spec's required set.

concepts.title: Concept-level requirements
concepts.description: Requirements every concept in the bundle must satisfy, beyond the spec's own.

default_stale_after.title: Stale-after duration
default_stale_after.description: How long a concept may go unedited before lint `stale` fires. Accepts "<n>h", "<n>d", "<n>w", or Effect's "<n> <unit>" long form.

agent.title: Agent actor
agent.description: The actor id an agent writes as `generated.by`.

humans.title: Human actors
humans.description: The humans allowed to verify concepts in this bundle: "human:<id>" ids or id globs ("human:spencer*"). Empty or absent lets any resolved identity verify; non-empty makes it an allow-list for okfit verify and the trust signal. Never an email address.

items.title: Actor or actor glob
items.description: An actor id ("human:spencer") or an id glob ("human:spencer*"; * matches any run of characters, ? one), matched case-insensitively.

actors.title: Actor identities
actors.description: Who authors and verifies concepts in this bundle.

broken_links.title: broken-links
broken_links.description: A link in a concept's body or frontmatter does not resolve. Default "warn".

missing_index.title: missing-index
missing_index.description: A concept-holding directory has no index.md. Default "warn".

unknown_type.title: unknown-type
unknown_type.description: A concept's type is not one of the config's declared [types.<Name>]. Default "error", off when no types are declared.

required_key_missing.title: required-key-missing
required_key_missing.description: A concept is missing a frontmatter key its type or concepts.required requires. Default "error".

field_value_unknown.title: field-value-unknown
field_value_unknown.description: A frontmatter field's value is not one of its declared values. Default "error".

require_verified_unmet.title: require-verified-unmet
require_verified_unmet.description: A concept whose type sets require_verified = true carries no verified entry and is not a draft. Default "error".

family_invalid.title: family-invalid
family_invalid.description: okfit's own integrity family does not match its shape. Default "error".

computation_runtime_missing.title: computation-runtime-missing
computation_runtime_missing.description: A referenced computation's runtime is not available. Default "error".

footnote_source_unknown.title: footnote-source-unknown
footnote_source_unknown.description: A footnote's source does not resolve. Default "warn".

footnote_undefined.title: footnote-undefined
footnote_undefined.description: A footnote reference has no matching definition line in the body. Default "warn".

log_frontmatter.title: log-frontmatter
log_frontmatter.description: log.md carries frontmatter, which the spec reserves against. Default "warn".

actor_prefix_unknown.title: actor-prefix-unknown
actor_prefix_unknown.description: An actor in generated.by, verified[].by or sources[].author uses a scheme other than human, team, process or a producer shape; it is accepted and read as non-human. Default "info".

actor_email.title: actor-email
actor_email.description: An actor in generated.by, verified[].by, integrity.verified.by or [actors].humans contains "@", so an email address or domain is stored in the bundle or its config. Use a human:<id> without the domain. Default "warn".

verified_actor_unknown.title: verified-actor-unknown
verified_actor_unknown.description: A human verified[].by or integrity.verified.by matches no entry of a non-empty [actors].humans. Silent when the list is empty. Default "warn".

legacy_timestamp.title: legacy-timestamp
legacy_timestamp.description: A concept uses the legacy timestamp field instead of generated.at. Default "info".

config_unknown_key.title: config-unknown-key
config_unknown_key.description: The config file declares a top-level key the schema does not recognize. Default "warn".

stale.title: stale
stale.description: A concept is past its stale_after instant. Default "info".

walk_unreadable.title: walk-unreadable
walk_unreadable.description: A directory in the bundle could not be read while walking. Default "warn".

frontmatter_missing.title: frontmatter-missing
frontmatter_missing.description: A .md file other than index.md or log.md has no frontmatter, so it is not a concept and is skipped (OKF 0.3 §3.2). Default "warn".

type_missing.title: type-missing
type_missing.description: A .md file's frontmatter has no non-empty string type, so it is not a concept and is skipped (OKF 0.3 §3.2). Default "warn".

symlink_escape.title: symlink-escape
symlink_escape.description: A file in the bundle is a symbolic link whose target lies outside the bundle root; it is not read and not part of the bundle (OKF 0.3 §3.2). Default "warn".

generated_at_drift.title: generated-at-drift
generated_at_drift.description: A committed concept's generated.at is missing or does not match its last body-changing commit, and is not otherwise authoritative (issue #19: a stamp recorded during the unchanged-body run survives a squash/rebase merge). Default "warn".

verified_drift.title: verified-drift
verified_drift.description: A concept's latest human verification no longer covers its current content: the body or authored frontmatter changed since, the binding (integrity.verified) is missing, a later human entry is unbound, or the bound verifier is not in a non-empty [actors].humans. Draft and deprecated concepts are exempt, since okfit verify refuses them. A signal to re-verify, not a gate. Default "warn".

status_missing.title: status-missing
status_missing.description: A concept carries neither status nor verified, so it silently reads as stable (issue #110). Off by default because the spec reads an absent status as stable; the software-project profile raises it to "warn".

source_resource_missing.title: source-resource-missing
source_resource_missing.description: A resource or sources[].resource path resolves neither in the bundle nor on disk relative to the concept (issue #106). Default "warn".

resource_ignored.title: resource-ignored
resource_ignored.description: A resource or sources[].resource path names a file that exists locally but is gitignored, so every other checkout sees it missing (issue #279). Skipped outside a git repository and under --skip-provenance. Default "error".

resource_untracked.title: resource-untracked
resource_untracked.description: A resource or sources[].resource path names a file that exists locally but git does not track yet; not raised once the file is staged (issue #279). Skipped outside a git repository and under --skip-provenance. Default "warn".

resource_outside_project.title: resource-outside-project
resource_outside_project.description: A resource value resolves outside the project root, so okfit never reads, stats or asks git about it; the value is reported from its text alone (okfit's repository check, not OKF). Default "info".

generated_missing.title: generated-missing
generated_missing.description: A concept has no generated block while actors.agent is configured, so okfit sync cannot stamp generated.at until the block exists (issue #73). Default "warn"; silent when actors.agent is unset.

publication_drift.title: publication-drift
publication_drift.description: A Publication's renders[].body is missing or no longer matches the current body of the concept it names, so the published page may restate stale facts. Default "warn".

publication_orphan.title: publication-orphan
publication_orphan.description: A Publication's surface or renders[].path does not resolve to a concept, or renders is not a list of { path, body } entries. Default "error".

surface_unmatched.title: surface-unmatched
surface_unmatched.description: A Surface's resource glob matches no file or directory; legitimate in a brand-new monorepo, so it only warns. Default "warn".

index_metadata_invalid.title: index-metadata-invalid
index_metadata_invalid.description: The bundle-root index.md frontmatter carries an okf_version that is not a quoted <major>.<minor> string, or a title, description or license that is not a string; the value is read best-effort. Default "warn".

entry_ignored.title: entry-ignored
entry_ignored.description: An entry or mapping the spec defines (a sources, verified or parameters entry, generated) lacks a REQUIRED key or has one okfit cannot read, so it is ignored (OKF 0.3 §11.2 rule 3). Default "warn".

value_malformed.title: value-malformed
value_malformed.description: A defined value okfit cannot read in its defined shape (wrong type, unparsable timestamp, malformed optional key) is read as absent; a malformed stale_after reads as malformed, never fresh (OKF 0.3 §5.5, §11.2). Default "warn".

value_unknown.title: value-unknown
value_unknown.description: A defined key carries a value outside its vocabulary (today: status); the value is kept and the concept is not read as current knowledge (OKF 0.3 §5.4, §11.2 rule 4). Default "warn".

lint.title: Lint severities
lint.description: Per-code severity overrides. Any key omitted keeps its default.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what this type represents.

guidance.description: Longer guidance shown to an authoring agent or human writing a concept of this type.

required.description: Frontmatter keys a concept of this type must carry, beyond `concepts.required`.

require_verified.description: Whether a concept of this type must carry a `verified` entry to satisfy lint `require-verified-unmet`; a concept with status draft is exempt.

values.description: The allowed values, each with a one-sentence description.

kind.description: "path": the value is a concept id or file path, not one of an enumerated set.

fields.description: Extension fields this type's frontmatter may declare.

types.title: Concept type declarations
types.description: One entry per concept type, keyed by type name.

description.description: One-sentence summary of what applying this tag means.

tags.title: Tag declarations
tags.description: One entry per tag, keyed by tag name.

title: okfit config
description:
okfit's TOML config file (OKF spec 4.2). Unrecognized top-level keys are preserved verbatim and produce a config-unknown-key warning, never a validation error.
https://github.com/spencerbeggs/okfit#configuration
